entities.name: Query Mur ligase
observations: 491 aa protein sequence; predicted molecular mass 51.66 kDa and theoretical pI 5.63.
Has strong homology to reviewed MurE proteins, including Pseudomonas aeruginosa Q59650 at 48.7% identity and 98.6% query coverage (E-value 6.56e-135).
Pfam domains: Mur_ligase_M (PF08245) at residues 111–310 and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) at residues 335–461.
Likely ATP-dependent UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu—meso-diaminopimelate ligase, EC 6.3.2.13; assignment is supported primarily by homology and conserved domain architecture.
Expected cofactor is Mg2+; likely cytosolic based on curated homolog annotations and absence of an apparent signal peptide or transmembrane segment.

entities.name: MurE ligase
observations: Bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis enzyme that adds meso-diaminopimelate to UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate.
Catalyzes: UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu + meso-DAP + ATP → UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu-meso-DAP + ADP + phosphate.
Participates in peptidoglycan biosynthesis, cell-wall biogenesis, cell division, and maintenance of bacterial cell shape.
Curated homologs are annotated as cytoplasmic/cytosolic and ATP- and magnesium-binding.
